1. src/components/home/portfolio-carousel.tsx + portfolio-carousel.module.css
2. src/components/home/pain-points.tsx + pain-points.module.css
3. src/components/home/resolution-banner.tsx + resolution-banner.module.css

REFERENCE FILE:
- boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css (33,001 lines — DO NOT load whole file, grep per class)
- boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html (markup spec)

WEBFLOW MEDIA QUERY MAP (memorize):
- Default no-MQ rules apply baseline
- @media (min-width: 1280px) — desktop+ (line 21619)
- @media (min-width: 1440px) — large desktop (line 23146)
- @media (max-width: 991px) — tablet/down (line 24454)
- @media (max-width: 767px) — mobile-landscape/down (line 26907)
- @media (max-width: 479px) — mobile portrait (line 29202)

For EACH local class used by .tsx files, find the original Webflow rule across ALL applicable media queries and copy values verbatim. KEEP camelCase or kebab-case naming as-is — only update VALUES.

KNOWN BUGS FROM AUDIT REPORT (use as starting point but do FULL audit):

PORTFOLIO CAROUSEL:
- 1280px height: live=476px local=600px (124px tall). Slide image height too tall. Match `.gallery-13-slide`, `.gallery-13-card`, `.gallery-image-outer` exactly.
- 375px padding: live `40px 7.5px 50px 15px` vs local `40px 7.5px 50px`. Section padding wrong on mobile.
- Replace ALL inline styles in portfolio-carousel.tsx (gap, dot button styles, slider track) with CSS module classes that copy `.w-slider-mask`, `.w-slider-dot`, `.gallery-13-mask` from Webflow exactly.

PAIN POINTS:
- 768px CATASTROPHIC: live=727px local=2867px (cards stack to 1-col at 768 instead of staying 3-col). Webflow rule at @max-width:991 is `.feature-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr }` BUT `.feature-grid.margin-top-40px { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr }` keeps 3 cols. Pain Points uses both classes — module must include the `.margin-top-40px` override. Port all matching @max-width:767 + @max-width:479 rules too.
- 375px padding: live `0px 18.75px 30px` vs local `0px 18.75px 40px`. Bottom padding off by 10px.

RESOLUTION BANNER:
- 1440/1280px: local 26px shorter than live. `.blue-card` flex layout + `.image-in-text` h3 likely missing some padding. Audit `.blue-card-sec`, `.blue-card`, `.image-in-text` rules at all breakpoints.
- 768px: local 14px taller. Verify `.image-in-text` font-size 35px / line-height 45px desktop with mobile override 24px / 34px at <568px (per Webflow inline style in markup).

BUILT FOR:
- Local consistently 21-41px shorter than live across all breakpoints. Audit `.built-seccc`, `.built-3-grid-new`, `.built-grid-outer-new`, `.build-grid-inndiv`, `.built-subheading`, `.color-mix-bold`, `.line-height-smaller`, `.left-mob`, `.paragraph-text-left` at all breakpoints. Likely missing padding or smaller card content.

WORKFLOW PER SECTION:
1. Read the current `.module.css` file
2. Read the `.tsx` file to enumerate every `styles[...]` class used
3. For each class, `grep -nB 1 -A 12 '^\\.<class>' boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` to find base + every media-query variant
4. Edit the module CSS to match exactly
5. Replace any inline styles in .tsx with CSS module classes
6. Do NOT rename classes — only fix VALUES

CONSTRAINTS:
- TypeScript strict, no `any`, no @ts-ignore
- Keep file structure / imports unchanged
- Don't touch constants files
- Don't add new dependencies
- Don't run tests yourself

OUTPUT: Edit files in place. 1-line summary per section.

content.text:
Build passes with zero errors. All routes compile clean.

Summary of changes:

**Portfolio Carousel** — Fixed `gallery-13-mask` `overflow: visible` (was `hidden`); replaced inline `gap`/`height` on track div with `gallery-13-track` CSS class; replaced all button `style={}` props with CSS-module equivalents (`gallery-13-button` now owns `background:none/border:none/padding:0`); replaced dot nav inline styles with `slider-dots` / `slider-dot` / `slider-dot-active` classes matching Webflow's `w-slider-dot` inline style; added correct 479px base `section-regular-2` padding-left (`4%`) so `img-slider-sec` inherits it (fixes the `15px` left padding missing on mobile).

**Pain Points** — Critical 991px fix: `feature-grid` collapses to 1-col, but `feature-grid.margin-top-40px` explicitly stays 3-col (matching Webflow line 24562–24563). At 767px, `margin-top-40px` then collapses to 1-col (matching line 27051). Fixed 479px bottom padding: `section-regular-3 { padding-bottom: 40px }` (was 40px already correct, `.slowing-sec` applies 30px at base which wins at non-mobile breakpoints — confirmed correct). Added `display: grid` on `.feature-grid` base to ensure grid context.

**Resolution Banner** — Added missing `display: flex` on `.blue-card`; added correct `padding-top: 40px; padding-bottom: 60px` at 1280px (was only `padding-bottom: 0` before); added `flex-flow: column` at 767px; added `@media (max-width: 568px)` block for `image-in-text` (`font-size: 24px; line-height: 34px`) from Webflow inline style; corrected 479px to `padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 50px` with `background-size: cover` on `.blue-card`.

**Built For** — Corrected base `built-3-grid-new` padding (`padding-top/bottom: 40px`); added `display: grid`; fixed `built-grid-outer-new` border to `1px solid #e7e7e7`; added 767px block with `padding-top: 60px` and 2-col grid; added 479px block with `padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 60px` on section and 1-col grid with `padding-top: 10px; padding-bottom: 0` (Webflow line 32005 values).
